item.title: Following the Innovation Party, ruling party's Park Ju-min also objects: "The Serious Crimes Investigation Office chief nominee should be reconsidered" (조국혁신당 이어 與 박주민도 “중수청장 후보 재고해야” 반발)
item.description:
Following the Innovation Party, ruling party's Park Ju-min also objects: "The Serious Crimes Investigation Office chief nominee should be reconsidered" (조국혁신당 이어 與 박주민도 “중수청장 후보 재고해야” 반발)

As the Ministry of the Interior and Safety has nominated Kim Ji-yong as the first chief of the Serious Crimes Investigation Office, the Innovation Party is opposing it, and Democratic Party lawmaker Park Ju-min has become the first ruling party lawmaker to request reconsideration of the appointment. (행정안전부가 김지용 초대 중대범죄수사청장 후보자를 제청한 것에 대해 조국혁신당이 반대하는 가운데, 더불어민주당 박주민 의원도 여당 의원 중 처음으로 인사 재고를 요청하고 나섰다.)

On the 8th, Rep. Park wrote on his Facebook page regarding Kim Ji-yong, the first chief nominee of the Serious Crimes Investigation Office, "As one of those who first proposed the Serious Crimes Investigation Office, I request of the President," and asked President Lee Jae-myung, "If a clear philosophy on the grand principle of 'separation of investigation and prosecution' is not confirmed, please reconsider this appointment." (박 의원은 8일 자신의 페이스북에 김지용 초대 중대범죄수사청장 후보자에 대해 “중수청을 처음 제안한 사람 중 한 사람으로서 대통령께 요청드린다”면서 “‘수사·기소 분리' 대원칙에 대한 분명한 철학이 확인되지 않는다면 이번 인사를 재고해달라”고 이재명 대통령에게 요청했다.)

Rep. Park said, "In that regard, Kim Ji-yong's past record cannot be taken lightly," noting, "While serving as head of the criminal affairs division at the Supreme Prosecutors' Office in 2022, Kim publicly opposed legislation to reduce prosecutorial investigative powers, citing the need for direct investigation." (박 의원은 “그런 점에서 김지용 후보자의 과거 행적을 가볍게 볼 수 없다”며 “김 후보자는 2022년 대검찰청 형사부장으로 재직하면서 직접 수사 필요성을 내세워 검찰 수사권 축소 입법에 공개적으로 반대했다”고 지적했다.)

He added, "The essence of the debate at the time was not whether to eliminate one supplementary investigation, but the grand principle of separating investigation and prosecution," and said, "I question whether it is appropriate for someone who publicly stated that the prosecution's direct investigative function should be maintained to become the inaugural chief of a new investigative agency that symbolizes the separation of investigation and prosecution." (또 “당시 논쟁의 본질은 보완수사 하나를 없애느냐 마느냐가 아니라 수사와 기소 분리라는 대원칙이었다”며 “검찰의 직접 수사 기능을 유지해야 한다는 입장을 공개적으로 밝혔던 분이 수사와 기소의 분리를 상징하는 새로운 수사기관의 초대 수장이 되는 것이 과연 적절한지 의문”이라고 했다.)

He further urged, "This is not simply because Kim is a former prosecutor. The problem is not his background but his philosophy," and stressed, "He must first explain what stance he has taken toward reforms that require relinquishing the powers of the organization he belonged to, whether he now clearly agrees with the separation of investigation and prosecution, and if his position has changed, when and why." (그러면서 “김 후보자가 단지 검찰 출신이어서가 아니다. 문제는 출신이 아니라 철학”이라며 “자신이 몸담았던 조직의 권한을 내려놓는 개혁에 어떤 태도를 취해왔는지, 지금은 수사·기소 분리 원칙에 분명히 동의하고 있는지, 입장이 바뀌었다면 언제 왜 바뀌었는지 먼저 설명해야 한다”고 촉구했다.)

The previous day, Innovation Party spokesperson Im Myung-hee also expressed regret over the nomination of Kim Ji-yong, saying, "Placing another prosecutor-turned official at the helm of a newly established investigative agency cannot escape criticism that the separation of investigation and prosecution exists only on paper." (전날 조국혁신당 임명희 대변인 역시 “신설되는 수사 전담 기관의 지휘관에 또다시 검찰 출신 인사를 앉히는 것은, 제도상으로만 수사와 기소를 분리했다는 비판을 피할 수 없다”며 김지용 후보자 제청에 대해 유감을 표했다.)

item.title: At Korea-Hosted Security Conference…Philippines and China Clash Publicly Over South China Sea Sovereignty (韓 주최 안보 회의서…필리핀·중국, ‘남중국해 영유권’ 두고 공개 충돌)
item.description:
At Korea-Hosted Security Conference…Philippines and China Clash Publicly Over South China Sea Sovereignty (韓 주최 안보 회의서…필리핀·중국, ‘남중국해 영유권’ 두고 공개 충돌 )

At a multilateral security conference hosted by our government in Seoul on the 8th, officials from the Philippines and China openly clashed over sovereignty in the South China Sea. During a public speech by the Philippine defense secretary, the Chinese side sent a note of rebuttal, which the Philippine secretary then rebutted in turn. (우리 정부가 서울에서 개최한 다자 안보 회의 석상에서, 필리핀과 중국 측이 남중국해 영유권을 둘러싸고 공개적으로 갈등을 빚는 일이 8일 발생했다. 필리핀 국방부 장관의 공개 발언 도중 중국 측이 반박하는 쪽지를 보내고, 이를 다시 필리핀 장관이 재반박한 것이다.)

Philippine Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro participated as a panelist in the first session of the plenary meeting of the Seoul Defense Dialogue (SDD), held by Korea's Ministry of National Defense at the Lotte Hotel in Seoul. (길베르토 테오도로 필리핀 국방장관은 이날 한국 국방부 주최로 더그랜드롯데 서울에서 열린 서울안보대화(SDD) 본회의 1세션에 패널로 참여했다.)

Secretary Teodoro delivered remarks centered on the need to uphold the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), stating, "Yet we can see that several states are not complying. This is something unlawful." (테오도로 장관은 유엔해양법협약(UNCLOS) 준수가 필요하다는 내용을 골자로 발언하며 “그런데도 여러 국가가 준수하지 않는 것을 볼 수 있다. 이것은 불법적인 것”이라고 말했다.)

The Philippines is currently embroiled in a territorial dispute with China over the South China Sea. As such, Secretary Teodoro's remarks were interpreted as targeting China. The Philippines filed a case with the Permanent Court of Arbitration (PCA) in 2013, alleging that China had violated UNCLOS, and received a de facto favorable ruling in 2016. However, China has not recognized the ruling and continues to assert sovereignty over most of the South China Sea to this day. (필리핀은 현재 중국과 남중국해 영유권을 두고 분쟁을 벌이고 있다. 이 때문에 테오도로 장관 발언은 중국을 겨냥한 발언으로 해석됐다. 필리핀은 2013년 중국이 UNCLOS를 위반했다며 국제상설중재재판소(PCA)에 소송을 제기했고, 2016년 사실상 승소 판결을 받았다. 하지만 중국은 판정을 인정하지 않은 채 현재도 남중국해 대부분에 대한 영유권 주장을 펼치고 있다.)

Midway through, a note believed to have come from the audience was handed to Secretary Teodoro. He said, "It seems to be a note from the Chinese side," and read its contents. The note conveyed the position that 'the PCA's South China Sea arbitration ruling is illegal and has no legally binding force.' (그러던 도중 청중에게서 온 것으로 추정되는 쪽지가 테오도로 장관에게 전달됐다. 그는 “중국 쪽에서 전달한 쪽지 같다”며 내용을 읽었다. 쪽지는 ‘PCA의 남중국해 중재 판정은 불법이고 법적 구속력이 없다’는 취지였다.)

He responded, "If this is the position that China has conveyed to me, it is an act of throwing the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea to the floor and trampling on it," adding that it also showed a lack of basic courtesy toward the host country, Korea. He continued, "This is no longer a gray zone. It is actual coercion, harassment, and an act of aggression," and then stated, "I will keep this paper as a souvenir to show, before a free audience, how desperate China is and how unconvincing their position is." (그는 “만약 이것이 중국이 제게 전달한 입장이라면, 유엔해양법협약을 바닥에 내던지고 짓밟는 행위”라면서 주최국인 한국에 갖춰야 할 기본적 예의도 없는 것이라고 했다. 이어 “이것은 더는 회색지대가 아니다. 실제적인 강압이자 괴롭힘이고 침략 행위”라고 한 뒤 “저는 자유로운 청중 앞에서 중국이 얼마나 절박하며 그들의 입장이 얼마나 설득력이 없는지를 보여주는 기념품으로 이 종이를 간직하겠다”고 했다.)

It has been reported that the person who handed the note to Secretary Teodoro that day was actually an official from the Chinese Embassy in Korea. This official reportedly asked a event staff member to deliver the note to Secretary Teodoro during the open dialogue, and the staff member, mistaking the official for a Philippine side contact, passed the note along as is. In the end, the maritime territorial conflict between the Philippines and China was laid bare on the public stage of an international forum held in Korea. (이날 테오도로 장관에게 쪽지를 전달한 것은 실제 주한 중국 대사관 관계자였던 것으로 알려졌다. 이 관계자가 행사 진행 요원에게 공개 대담 중인 테오도로 장관에게 이 쪽지를 전달해 달라고 부탁했고, 요원이 이를 필리핀 측 관계자로 오해하고 쪽지를 그대로 전달했다는 것이다. 결과적으로 한국에서 열린 국제 포럼 공개 석상에서 필리핀과 중국의 영해 갈등이 그대로 노출된 셈이다.)

In this regard, China had previously imposed entry bans and transaction restrictions on Secretary Teodoro and his family in June, alleging that he had harmed China's interests with 'false claims.' At the time, the Philippine Department of Foreign Affairs issued a statement criticizing China's sanctions as "an unfriendly act that further complicates bilateral relations." (이와 관련, 중국은 지난 6월 ‘허위 주장’으로 자국의 이익을 훼손했다며 테오도로 장관과 그 가족에게 입국 금지 및 거래 제한 제재를 가하기도 했다. 당시 필리핀 외교부는 성명을 내고 중국의 제재에 대해 “양국 관계를 더욱 복잡하게 만드는 비우호적 행위”라고 비판했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Visits Constitutional Assembly, "Pushing Constitutional Amendment with Open Stance" (김민석, 헌정회 방문 “열린 자세로 개헌 추진”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok Visits Constitutional Assembly, "Pushing Constitutional Amendment with Open Stance" (김민석, 헌정회 방문 “열린 자세로 개헌 추진”)

Democratic Party of Korea leader Kim Min-seok visited the Constitutional Assembly at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, on the afternoon of the 8th to pay a courtesy call on Assembly Chairman Chung Dae-chul and senior veteran politicians. It was his first visit to the Constitutional Assembly since taking office. Chairman Chung said that day, "The constitutional amendment must be achieved under this administration," and Representative Kim also reaffirmed his commitment to pursuing the amendment, stating, "The party will raise and discuss the constitutional amendment issue with an open attitude while upholding democratic principles." (더불어민주당 김민석 대표가 8일 오후 서울 여의도 국회 헌정회를 찾아 정대철 헌정회장과 원로 정치인들을 예방했다. 취임 이후 첫 헌정회 방문이다. 정 회장은 이날 “이번 정부에서 개헌을 이뤄야 한다”고 했고, 김 대표도 “당은 열린 자세로 민주주의 원칙 지키며 개헌문제도 제기하고 토론해가겠다”며 재차 개헌 추진 의지를 밝혔다.)

Chairman Chung Dae-chul offered his congratulations that day, saying, "As a member of the ruling party, Representative Kim is in a position to help the Lee Jae-myung administration succeed, while also, as a legislator, needing to speak his mind and offer counsel to the government." He then referenced the Constitutional Assembly's ongoing campaign for a "decentralized presidential responsibility system" constitutional amendment, adding, "The amendment must be achieved under this administration without fail." (정대철 회장은 이날 “김 대표는 여당의 일원으로서 이재명 정부가 성공하도록 돕는 동시에, 입법부 의원으로서 정부에 할 말은 하고 충고해야 하는 위치에 있다”며 축하 인사를 건넸다. 이어 헌정회가 추진 중인 ‘분권형 대통령 책임제’ 개헌 운동을 언급하며 “이번 정부에서는 반드시 개헌을 이뤄야 한다”고 했다.)

In response to People Power Party floor leader Chung Jin-suk's remarks earlier that morning that "there will be no constitutional amendment under this government," Representative Kim rebutted, "I don't think the preconditions implied in those remarks are actually major obstacles. The answer is already contained in the statement that we will proceed while adhering to the procedural principles of the current Constitution and laws." (김 대표는 이날 오전 정점식 국민의힘 원내대표가 “이 정부 하에서는 개헌이 없다”고 발언한 것을 두고 “그 발언 안에 담긴 전제 조건들이 사실상 큰 걸림돌은 아니라고 본다”며 “현행 헌법과 법률의 절차적 원칙을 지키며 추진하겠다는 말에 이미 답이 담겨 있다”고 반박했다.)

He went on to mention that when he recently visited the People Power Party, he saw photos of former Presidents Rhee Syng-man, Park Chung-hee, and Kim Young-sam hanging together, saying, "When I asked an AI (artificial intelligence) model, it turned out that President Kim Young-sam was the figure who created the May 18 special law, established the Mangwol-dong cemetery, and brought Chun Doo-hwan and Roh Tae-woo to justice—essentially defining the so-called 'civilian government identity.' The National Assembly should begin constitutional amendment discussions at minimum on the foundation of embracing the spirit of May 18." (이어 자신이 최근 국민의힘을 방문했을 때 이승만·박정희·김영삼 전 대통령의 사진이 함께 걸려 있는 것을 봤다며 “AI(인공지능) 모델에 물어보니 김영삼 대통령이 5·18 특별법을 만들고 망월동 묘지를 조성했으며 전두환·노태우를 단죄한, 이른바 ‘문민정부 정체성’을 규정한 인물이더라”며 “국회가 최소한 5·18 정신을 수용하는 토대 위에서 개헌 논의를 시작해야 한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the restructuring of power structures, he said, "Whether it's a runoff voting system, a second-term presidency, or the level of decentralization, we can go as far as the public agrees upon," while declining to commit to specific plans. He stated that this position "is the same as President Lee Jae-myung's thinking." (권력구조 개편과 관련해선 “결선투표든 중임제든, 분권을 어느 수준까지 할지든, 국민이 동의하는 선까지 가면 된다”며 구체적 방안에는 선을 그었다. 그는 이 같은 입장이 “이재명 대통령의 생각과 같다”고 했다.)

Kim Sang-ho, spokesperson for the Constitutional Assembly, said of the closed-door discussions, "The Constitutional Assembly side made two requests to Representative Kim: first, to lead politics of harmony and unity based on the spirit of the Democratic Party and the spirit of Kim Dae-jung, and second, that the constitutional amendment is not an issue the ruling party should pursue unilaterally, so it must be advanced through agreement between the ruling and opposition parties." (김상호 헌정회 대변인은 비공개 대담 내용과 관련해 “헌정회 측은 김 대표에게 ‘민주당 정신과 김대중 정신에 입각해 화합과 통합의 정치를 이끌어달라’는 점과 ‘개헌은 여당이 일방적으로 추진할 사안이 아니므로 여야 합의에 의해 추진해야 한다’는 두 가지를 당부했다”고 전했다.)

Representative Kim revealed that the secretary accompanying him that day was Kim Jong-dae, the grandson of the late former President Kim Dae-jung—a senior figure of the Constitutional Assembly—and the son of former lawmaker Kim Hong-up. When Kim said, "What's interesting is that the secretary accompanying me is also a member of the Constitutional Assembly family—Kim Jong-dae, grandson of President Kim Dae-jung and son of lawmaker Kim Hong-up," those in attendance at the Constitutional Assembly responded warmly, saying, "Oh, Jong-dae's here." (김 대표는 이날 자신을 수행한 비서관이 헌정회 원로인 고(故) 김대중 전 대통령의 손자이자 김홍업 전 의원의 아들인 김종대씨라고 밝혔다. 김 대표가 “흥마로운 게 저를 수행해서 온 저희 비서관이 역시 헌정회 가족인 김대중 대통령님의 손자이고 김홍업 의원의 아들인 김종대”라고 하자, 헌정회 참석자들 사이에서 “아유, 종대 왔구나”라는 반응이 나왔다.)

item.title: Military Cooperation with France, Joint Navy and Air Force Exercises Planned (프랑스와 군사협력, 해군·공군 연합훈련한다)
item.description:
Military Cooperation with France, Joint Navy and Air Force Exercises Planned (프랑스와 군사협력, 해군·공군 연합훈련한다)

President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to France, held a summit with French President Emmanuel Macron at the Élysée Palace in Paris on the 8th (local time), discussing whether to join the international coalition led by France for freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, as well as bilateral military and technological cooperation. Meeting for the second consecutive day following the Lumière Summit held the previous day in Saint-Paul-de-Vence, the two leaders shared a working lunch followed by a summit and a joint press conference. (프랑스를 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 8일(현지 시각) 파리 엘리제궁에서 에마뉘엘 마크롱 프랑스 대통령과 정상회담을 갖고, 프랑스가 주도하는 호르무즈 해협 자유 항행을 위한 국제 연대 동참 여부와 양국 간 군사·기술 협력 등을 논의했다. 전날 생폴드방스에서 열린 뤼미에르 서밋에 이어 이틀 연속으로 만난 양국 정상은 이날 단독 오찬에 이어 정상회담과 공동 언론 발표를 함께 했다.)

In the joint press conference after the summit, President Lee stated, "Last April, I participated in the conference on the Strait of Hormuz led by France and the United Kingdom and expressed the Republic of Korea's commitment to contributing to the stability of the strait and freedom of navigation," adding, "The Republic of Korea and France will continue close coordination to ensure the swift restoration of freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and the stability of global supply chains." This can be interpreted as an intent to continue participating in discussions on the "international escort flotilla" being planned by France and the United Kingdom to protect oil tankers and merchant vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz. Earlier, in an interview with the French daily Le Monde, President Lee addressed U.S. President Donald Trump, who has been pressing for Korean deployment to Hormuz, saying, "I do not think he is questioning the sustainability of the Korea-U.S. alliance" and "President Trump's stance reflects the demands of a changing era." (이 대통령은 정상회담 뒤 공동 언론 발표에서 “지난 4월 저는 프랑스와 영국이 주도한 호르무즈 해협 회의에 참여해 해협의 안정과 항행의 자유를 위한 대한민국의 기여 의지를 밝혔다”며 “대한민국과 프랑스는 호르무즈 해협에서의 항행의 자유와 글로벌 공급망의 안정이 조속히 회복될 수 있도록 긴밀한 공조를 계속 이어갈 것”이라고 밝혔다. 프랑스와 영국이 호르무즈 해협을 통과하는 유조선과 상선 등을 보호하기 위해 구상 중인 ‘국제 호위 선단’ 논의에 계속 참여하겠다는 취지로 볼 수 있다. 앞서 이 대통령은 프랑스 일간지 르몽드 인터뷰에서 호르무즈 파병 압박에 나선 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령을 향해 “한·미 동맹 지속 가능성에 의문을 제기하고 있다고 생각하지 않는다”며 “트럼프 대통령 입장은 변화하는 시대 요구를 반영하자는 것”이라고 했다.)

Separate from the Hormuz deployment issue, agreements to strengthen military cooperation between South Korea and France were reached at the day's summit. The two leaders signed two agreements, six MOUs, and one private investment deal, among which the "Amended Protocol to the Military Security of Information Agreement" includes provisions to strengthen the stability and reliability of military information exchanges between the two countries. The defense ministries of both nations also agreed to expedite the conclusion of a "Mutual Logistics Support Agreement" outlining procedures for logistics support during wartime and peacetime. (이날 정상회담에서는 호르무즈 파병과 별도로 한국과 프랑스의 군사 협력을 강화하는 합의들이 이뤄졌다. 이날 양국 정상은 협정 2건, MOU 6건, 민간 투자 협약 1건을 체결했는데, 그중 ‘군사비밀정보보호협정 개정의정서’는 양국 간 군사 정보 교류의 안정성과 신뢰성을 강화하는 내용을 담았다. 전시·평시의 군수 지원 절차를 규정하는 ‘상호군수지원협정’을 조속히 체결하는 방안도 양국 국방부가 협의하기로 했다.)

President Lee stated, "The 'Pegasus' joint air force exercise between our two countries, to be held in Seoul next week, and the mutual port visits by our navies scheduled for the second half of this year will serve as excellent examples of enhanced mutual understanding and interoperability between our militaries, as well as closer strategic cooperation." He added, "France is playing a central role in rallying European capabilities to end the war in Ukraine and restore peace," and "The two countries will continue to work with the international community to restore peace and rebuild Ukraine." (이 대통령은 “다음 주 서울에서 실시되는 양국 공군의 ‘페가스’ 합동 훈련과 올해 하반기 예정된 양국 해군의 상호 기항 역시 양국 군 사이 상호 이해와 운용성을 높이고 더욱 긴밀해진 전략적 공조를 잘 보여주는 사례가 될 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “프랑스는 우크라이나 전쟁의 종식과 평화 회복을 위해 유럽의 역량을 결집하는 데 중심적인 역할을 하고 있다”며 “양국은 앞으로도 우크라이나의 평화 회복과 재건을 위해 국제사회와 함께 노력해 나갈 것”이라고 했다.)

Progress was also made in nuclear energy cooperation, which was discussed during President Macron's visit to South Korea last April. Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power and the French nuclear fuel company Orano signed a "Letter of Intent for Long-Term Enrichment Services Supply Cooperation" regarding uranium enrichment. The presidential office stated, "Building on the agreement with President Macron in April, a high-level dialogue channel for civilian nuclear cooperation will also be established." (마크롱 대통령의 지난 4월 방한 당시 논의된 원자력 분야 협력도 진전이 있었다. 한국수력원자력과 프랑스 핵연료 기업 오라노는 우라늄 농축에 관한 ‘장기 농축역무 공급 협력 의향서’를 체결했다. 청와대는 “마크롱 대통령과 지난 4월 합의를 토대로 민간 원자력 협력을 위한 고위급 대화 채널도 개설하기로 했다”고 밝혔다.)

Memorandums of understanding on cooperation in artificial intelligence, semiconductors, and quantum technology were also signed. Earlier, in his Le Monde interview, President Lee noted, "Beyond the rapid technological advances of competitors like China, the artificial intelligence revolution is fundamentally reshaping industrial ecosystems and order," adding, "Korea will maintain its leading position in advanced industries while continuously creating new growth engines." (인공지능·반도체·양자 기술 분야 협력 양해각서도 체결됐다. 앞서 이 대통령은 르몽드 인터뷰를 통해서도 “중국과 같은 경쟁국들의 급속한 기술 발전 외에도 인공지능 혁명은 산업 생태계와 질서를 근본적으로 뒤흔들고 있다”면서 “한국은 첨단 산업 분야에서 선도적 위치를 유지하면서 새로운 성장 동력을 지속적으로 창출하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

A fund will also be established to foster the cultural and content industries. At the Lumière Summit the previous day, President Lee had pledged, "Over the next five years, South Korea and France will each invest 500 million euros (approximately 800 billion won) in the film and video industries," stating that "investment in domestic film and video industries will lead to joint investment and production." (문화·콘텐츠 산업 육성을 위해서도 펀드를 마련하기로 했다. 이 대통령은 전날 뤼미에르 서밋에서 “향후 5년간 한국과 프랑스가 영화·영상 산업 분야에 각각 5억유로(약 8000억원)를 투자하겠다”고 약속했다며 “자국 영화·영상 산업 투자와 함께 공동 투자·제작으로 이어질 것”이라고 밝힌 바 있다.)

After the summit, President Lee also attended a Korea-France Business Roundtable. The event was attended by business leaders from both countries, including Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong. On the French side, attendees included Jacques, chairman of the Korea-France Economic Cooperation Committee of MEDEF, BNP Paribas Chairman Jean Lemierre, and L'Oréal CEO Nicolas Hieronimus. (정상회담을 마친 이 대통령은 한국·프랑스 비즈니스 라운드 테이블에도 나섰다. 이번 행사에는 이재용 삼성전자 회장을 비롯해 양국 기업인이 참석했다. 프랑스 측에서는 프랑스경제인협회 한·불 경제협력위원회 자코브 위원장을 비롯해 BNP 파리바 르미에르 회장, 로레알 이에로니무스 대표 등이 참석했다.)

Prior to the summit, President Lee attended an official welcome ceremony at the Arc de Triomphe in Paris. Encouraging Korean War veterans and their families, he said, "Thanks to you, the Republic of Korea has developed into a respected nation," "We can never forget you," and "I will prove that the sacrifices of your fathers and uncles were not in vain." (정상회담에 앞서 이 대통령은 파리 개선문 공식 환영식에 참석했다. 이 대통령은 한국전 참전 용사와 유족을 격려하며 “덕분에 대한민국이 인정받는 나라로 발전했다” “결코 잊어버릴 수 없다” “삼촌의 희생이 헛되지 않다는 것을 증명해 드리겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Genencell Received Most Corrective Requests at 14 Items... MFDS Did Not Request Additional Supplementation (14건 최다 지적 받은 제넨셀… 식약처, 추가보완 요구 안 해)
item.description:
Genencell Received Most Corrective Requests at 14 Items... MFDS Did Not Request Additional Supplementation (14건 최다 지적 받은 제넨셀… 식약처, 추가보완 요구 안 해)

Genencell, a pharmaceutical company under suspicion of lobbying for a COVID-19 drug, received requests for supplementation on 14 items from the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) before its clinical trial approval in 2021. This was confirmed on the 8th to be the highest number among the 21 cases of "new substance COVID-19 treatments" that the MFDS approved for clinical trials between 2020 and 2022. In particular, the issues the MFDS requested to be addressed included core aspects of clinical trials such as "inadequate safety measures for adverse reactions." When Genencell submitted supplementary materials, the MFDS approved the clinical trial without a second round of corrective requests. Later, during court proceedings, it was revealed that Genencell had submitted "falsified data" that omitted side effects such as hamster deaths. <<> According to the "Status of COVID-19 Treatment Clinical Trial Approvals" received by the office of People Power Party lawmaker Han Ji-ah from the MFDS, the average number of corrective requests issued by the MFDS for the 21 new substance-based COVID-19 treatments (from 15 pharmaceutical companies) between 2020 and 2022 was 7.8 items. Genencell's COVID-19 treatment received about twice that number. Genencell was reportedly asked to address not only inadequate safety measures for adverse reactions but also core clinical trial items such as the failure to establish a safety monitoring committee and a lack of statistical validity. <<> On average, it took 71.6 days from the date of submission for new substance treatments to receive MFDS clinical trial approval. In contrast, Genencell's treatment, which received the most corrective requests, was approved in just 33 days—about half the average. Including Genencell, a total of 9 new substance COVID-19 treatments received "batch corrective requests" on 10 or more items. Of these, the MFDS requested a second round of supplementation for 5 cases (55.6%). When a second corrective request was issued, the time to approval increased significantly to an average of 126.4 days. <<> Among the opposition party, there is talk that "from Genencell's perspective, avoiding a second corrective request from the MFDS must have been urgent." According to prosecution investigations, immediately after receiving corrective requests on 14 items from the MFDS on September 30, 2021, Genencell founder Professor Kang (surname) began full-scale lobbying. Subsequently, a broker named Yang (surname), who had a personal connection with then-lawmaker Kim of the Democratic Party of Korea, made a request to Kim, and on October 12 of that year, Kim contacted then-MFDS Commissioner Kim Kang-lip, asking him to "handle it quickly." <<> Six days later, Genencell submitted supplementary materials addressing the 14 items to the MFDS. Afterwards, without any further requests for supplementation, the MFDS approved the clinical trial for Genencell's treatment on October 26. Lawmaker Han Ji-ah stated, "The key question is how Kim's lobbying phone call influenced the review of supplementary materials and final approval throughout the entire process from submission to approval." (코로나 신약 로비 의혹을 받는 제약사 제넨셀은 2021년 임상시험 승인 전 식품의약품안전처로부터 14개 항목에 대해 보완 요구를 받았다. 이는 2020~2022년 식약처가 임상시험을 허가한 ‘신(新)물질 코로나 치료제’ 21건 가운데 최다였던 것으로 8일 확인됐다. 특히 식약처가 보완을 요구한 사안은 ‘이상 반응 안전 조치 부실’ 등 임상시험의 핵심 항목들이었다. 제넨셀이 보완 자료를 제출하자 식약처는 2차 보완 요구 없이 임상시험을 승인했다. 이후 재판 과정에서 제넨셀은 햄스터 사망과 같은 부작용이 삭제된 ‘가짜 자료’를 제출한 것으로 드러났다.)

item.title: Blue House Says on Kim Seung-won and Yong Hye-in Controversy: "Must Go Through Confirmation Hearings" (靑, 김승원·용혜인 논란에 “인사청문회 거쳐야”)
item.description:
Blue House Says on Kim Seung-won and Yong Hye-in Controversy: "Must Go Through Confirmation Hearings" (靑, 김승원·용혜인 논란에 “인사청문회 거쳐야”)

The Blue House said on the 8th regarding Kim Seung-won, nominee for Minister of Justice, and Yong Hye-in, nominee for Minister of Gender Equality and Family, that "they must go through confirmation hearings." Within the Democratic Party, negative opinions have also been conveyed to the Blue House over growing controversy surrounding nominee Yong's concurrent holding of the ministerial post and a proportional representation seat in the National Assembly, but the Blue House repeated its existing stance of waiting to see how the hearings unfold. (청와대는 8일 김승원 법무부·용혜인 성평등가족부 장관 후보자에 대해 “인사청문회를 거쳐야 한다”고 했다. 더불어민주당에서도 청와대에 장관직과 비례대표 국회의원직 겸직 논란이 커진 용 후보자에 대해 부정적 의견을 전달한 상황인데, 청문회를 지켜보겠다는 기존 입장을 되풀이한 것이다.)

However, a key ruling camp official said the same day, "The party and the Blue House have already reached a consensus that appointing nominee Yong will be difficult," adding, "I expect the president to settle (the matter of her fate) after returning from his visit to France." (다만 여권 핵심 관계자는 이날 “이미 당청이 용 후보자에 대해선 임명이 어렵다는 데 의견이 일치하는 상황”이라며 “대통령이 프랑스 순방을 다녀온 뒤 (용 후보자 거취를) 정리할 것으로 본다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Hong Ik-pyo, senior presidential secretary for political affairs, appeared on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel that day and said regarding the issue of withdrawing the indictment in President Lee Jae-myeong's case, "This is something that will naturally happen after the case itself is clearly revealed to be a fabricated prosecution," adding, "I believe President Lee's focus is more on the fabricated prosecution than on the withdrawal of the indictment." He continued, "If there is a problem of fabricated prosecution and it is clearly confirmed, investigative agencies can naturally (withdraw the indictment) in accordance with crimes such as distortion of law." (한편, 홍익표 청와대 정무수석은 이날 김어준 씨 유튜브에 출연해 이재명 대통령 사건 공소 취소 문제에 대해 “사건 자체가 명확하게 조작 기소라고 밝혀지고 난 이후에 자연스럽게 이뤄질 일”이라며 “이 대통령의 관점은 공소 취소보다는 조작 기소에 더 방점이 있다고 생각한다”고 했다. 이어 “조작기소 문제가 있는데 명백히 확인된다면 수사기관이 자연스럽게, 법 왜곡죄 등에 따라서도 (공소 취소를) 할 수 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding the controversy over extending the presidential term through constitutional amendment, Senior Secretary Hong also said, "It is regrettable that the controversy is growing despite clear statements," and "The president will express his intentions more clearly (soon)." (홍 수석은 연임 개헌 논란에 대해서도 “분명히 얘기했는데도 논란이 커지는 것은 유감스럽다”며 “(조만간) 좀 더 분명하게 대통령께서 의사를 밝히실 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Is This the 'Yong Hye-in Party' Regional and Provincial Office? (여기가 ‘용혜인黨’ 시·도당 사무실?)
item.description:
Is This the 'Yong Hye-in Party' Regional and Provincial Office? (여기가 ‘용혜인黨’ 시·도당 사무실?)

Suspicions were raised on the 8th that most of the regional and provincial party offices of the Basic Income Party, to which Yong Hye-in, the nominee for Minister of Gender Equality and Family, belongs, are registered at locations such as farms or apartments. Opposition circles have pointed out, "Isn't this a case of setting up ghost offices in the regions to meet party establishment requirements and then pocketing government subsidies?" (용혜인 성평등가족부 장관 후보자가 소속된 기본소득당의 지역 시·도당 사무실 대부분이 농장이나 아파트 등에 등록돼 있다는 의혹이 8일 제기됐다. 야권에선 “정당 설립 요건을 맞추기 위해 지역에 유령 사무실을 마련하고 국고보조금을 타낸 것 아니냐”는 지적이 나왔다.)

According to the office of Rep. Kim Jae-jung of the People Power Party on that day, the Basic Income Party's South Gyeongsang Provincial Party and Busan and Incheon City Parties were found to have registered their addresses in apartments. The Gwangju-Jeonnam Provincial Party was found to be registered at a house, while the South Chungcheong and North Jeolla Provincial Parties were each registered at farms owned by their respective provincial party chairs. In other words, 6 out of the party's 10 regional and provincial party offices were based in places like apartments or farms. (이날 국민의힘 김정재 의원실 등에 따르면, 기본소득당 경남도당과 부산·인천시당은 각각 아파트에 주소를 등록한 것으로 파악됐다. 광주전남도당은 주택에, 충남·전북도당은 각각 도당위원장 소유 농장에 주소가 등록돼 있는 것으로 나타났다. 기본소득당의 시·도당 10곳 중 6곳이 아파트나 농장 등에 적을 둔 것이다.)

The current Political Parties Act requires a party to have at least 5 regional and provincial parties nationwide, and each regional or provincial party is required to secure more than 1,000 party members residing in that region. If these legally stipulated numbers of regional and provincial parties and party members are not met, the party could face revocation of its registration. Having an address in an apartment or house for a regional or provincial party office is not inherently problematic. However, opposition circles are raising suspicions that the Basic Income Party may have fraudulently registered some regional and provincial parties to meet legal requirements. (현행 정당법은 정당이 전국에 5개 이상의 시·도당을 두도록 하고, 각 시·도당은 해당 지역에 주소를 둔 당원 1000명 이상을 확보하도록 규정하고 있다. 이 같은 법정 시·도당 수와 당원 수 요건을 충족하지 못할 경우 정당 등록 취소 대상이 될 수 있다. 시·도당 주소지가 아파트나 주택이라고 해서 무조건 문제가 되는 것은 아니다. 다만 야권에선 기본소득당이 법정 요건을 맞추기 위해 일부 지역에서 허위로 시·도당을 등록한 것 아니냐는 의혹을 제기하고 있다.)

The Basic Income Party's subsidies allocated to its regional and provincial parties in the first half of this year are known to amount to approximately 150 million won. The People Power Party said, "Among the regional and provincial parties that received this grant, whether taxpayers' money was provided to those with no substantive activity must be thoroughly verified." (기본소득당이 올해 상반기 시·도당에 배분한 지원액은 약 1억5000만원 수준으로 알려졌다. 국민의힘은 “이 교부금을 지원받은 시·도당 중 실질적 활동이 없는 곳에 국민 세금이 지원됐는지 철저히 검증해야 한다”고 했다.)

Regarding this, Rep. Joo Jin-woo of the People Power Party said he would request investigations from the National Election Commission and the police. At a press conference at the National Assembly that day, Rep. Joo said, "Anyone can see that conducting official party activities is impossible in such places," and added, "If [the party] has not secured more than 5 legitimate regional and provincial parties, it is a clear violation of the law. This is grounds for revoking the Basic Income Party's registration." (국민의힘 주진우 의원은 이에 대해 중앙선거관리위원회와 경찰에 조사를 의뢰하겠다고 했다. 주 의원은 이날 국회 기자회견에서 “누가 보더라도 공적인 정당 활동 업무 수행이 불가능하다”며 “5개 이상의 정상적인 시도당을 갖추지 못했다면 법률을 명백히 위반한 것이다. 기본소득당의 정당 등록 취소 사유”라고 했다.)

The Basic Income Party countered that day, saying, "Our regional and provincial parties were founded in compliance with legal requirements and have continued substantive local activities," and argued, "Calling them 'ghost parties,' 'waste of taxpayers' money,' and even raising the issue of revoking party registration merely because residences were registered as offices is a political attack that ignores current law and actual local activities." (기본소득당은 이날 “기본소득당 시·도당은 법정 요건을 갖춰 창당하고 실질적인 지역 활동을 이어왔다”며 “주거지를 사무소로 등록했다는 이유만으로 ‘유령 정당’, ‘혈세 낭비’, 나아가 정당 등록취소까지 거론하는 것은 현행법과 실제 지역 활동을 외면한 정치공세”라고 반박했다.)

item.title: Calls to Reform "Satellite Party" System But No Progress (“위성정당 제도 손봐야” 말 나오지만 진척 없어)
item.description:
Calls to Reform "Satellite Party" System But No Progress (“위성정당 제도 손봐야” 말 나오지만 진척 없어)

Since satellite parties first emerged in 2020, both the ruling and opposition parties have discussed ways to prevent them, yet no substantial progress has been made. Recent controversies surrounding Yong Hye-in, the nominee for Minister of Gender Equality and Family, who was elected twice as a proportional representation lawmaker through the Democratic Party of Korea's satellite party, have reignited criticism of the harms of satellite parties. However, political circles say, "Unless the Democratic Party and the People Power Party take active steps, the two parties' satellite party tactics are highly likely to be repeated in the 2028 general election as well." (여야는 2020년 위성정당이 등장한 때부터 이를 막는 방안을 거론해 왔으나, 실질적인 진척은 없는 상태다. 더불어민주당 위성정당으로 두 차례 비례대표 국회의원에 당선된 용혜인 성평등가족부 장관 후보자를 두고 최근 각종 논란이 일면서 위성정당의 폐해에 대한 지적이 다시 나오지만, 정치권에서는 “민주당과 국민의힘이 적극적으로 나서지 않는다면 다음 2028년 총선에서도 양당의 위성정당 꼼수가 되풀이될 가능성이 높다”는 말이 나온다.)

This stems from a "prisoner's dilemma" structure: if one of the two parties creates a satellite party and the other stays put, the latter unilaterally loses seats. In both the 2020 and 2024 general elections, the two parties each created satellite parties out of fear that if the other side did so, they would lose seats. President Lee Jae-myung also advocated banning satellite parties ahead of the 2024 election but later reversed his stance, saying, "Given the reality that the People Power Party is forming a satellite party, we have no choice but to respond to secure seats." (이는 양당 가운데 한쪽이 위성정당을 만드는데 다른 한쪽이 가만히 있으면 의석에서 일방적으로 손해를 보게 되는 ‘죄수의 딜레마’ 구조 때문이다. 2020·2024년 두 차례 총선에서 양당은 상대방이 위성정당을 만들면 자기들이 의석을 잃게 된다는 이유로 위성정당을 만들었다. 이재명 대통령도 2024년 총선을 앞두고 위성정당 금지를 주장했지만 “국민의힘이 위성정당을 창당하는 현실 속에서는 의석 확보를 위해 불가피하게 대응할 수밖에 없다”며 말을 바꿨다.)

During the 21st National Assembly, when satellite parties first appeared, multiple bills to ban them were proposed within the Democratic Party as well. The stance was to keep the semi-linked proportional representation system intact while blocking satellite parties. In contrast, the People Power Party insisted on reverting the electoral system to the previous parallel system of constituency and proportional seats. With the two parties' positions at odds, no legislation was ever enacted. (위성정당이 처음 생겼던 21대 국회에서는 민주당에서도 위성정당 금지 법안이 여럿 나왔다. 준연동형 비례대표제는 그대로 두고, 위성정당만 막자는 입장이었기 때문이다. 반면 국민의힘은 선거제를 과거의 지역구·비례대표 병립형으로 되돌려야 한다는 입장이었다. 양당 입장이 엇갈리면서 아무런 입법도 이뤄지지 않았다.)

In the 22nd National Assembly, no discussions between the two parties are underway. The Democratic Party's think tank, the Democracy Research Institute, issued an opinion on the 1st calling for "reform of the semi-linked proportional representation system with the prevention of satellite parties as a major premise," but the following day, Democratic Party lawmaker Park Beom-kye effectively expressed opposition to legally banning satellite parties, stating, "There is room to view it as conflicting with the freedom to establish political parties." (22대 국회에서는 양당 간 논의가 진행되지 않고 있다. 민주당 싱크탱크 민주연구원이 지난 1일 ‘위성정당 방지를 대전제로 한 준연동형 비례대표제 개혁’이 필요하다는 의견을 냈지만, 이튿날 민주당 박범계 의원은 위성정당을 법으로 금지하는 방안에 대해 “정당 설립의 자유와 충돌한다고 볼 여지가 있다”며 사실상 반대 입장을 밝혔다.)

Within the People Power Party, lawmaker Na Kyung-won has decided to propose the "Satellite Party Taxpayer Money Prevention Act" targeting nominee Yong. The core of the bill is to prevent those elected under a satellite party and then returning to their original party from receiving government subsidies. Na also plans to propose an amendment to the election law to return to the parallel voting system. However, at the party level, the People Power Party is not reviewing a satellite party ban or restoring the previous electoral system. (국민의힘에서는 나경원 의원이 용 후보자를 겨냥해 ‘위성정당 혈세 먹튀 방지법’을 발의하기로 했다. 위성정당 소속으로 당선된 뒤 원래 당으로 돌아갈 경우, 국고 보조금을 받지 못하게 하는 것이 골자다. 나 의원은 병립형 선거제로 복귀하는 선거법 개정안도 발의할 예정이다. 그러나 국민의힘 차원에서는 위성정당 금지법이나 선거제 원상 회복을 검토하지 않고 있다.)

The ruling and opposition parties have not even formed the National Assembly's Special Committee on Political Reform, which should discuss electoral system overhaul. An official from the National Assembly Speaker's office said, "We'll see whether the two parties discuss it while looking at the September regular session schedule." (여야는 선거제 개편을 논의해야 하는 국회 정치개혁특별위원회는 구성조차 못 하고 있다. 국회의장실 관계자는 “9월 정기국회 일정을 보면서 여야가 논의하지 않겠느냐”고 했다.)

item.title: "There Will Be No Constitutional Amendment Under a Lee Jae-myung Government" (“이재명 정부에서 개헌은 없다”)
item.description:
"There Will Be No Constitutional Amendment Under a Lee Jae-myung Government" (“이재명 정부에서 개헌은 없다”)

People Power Party floor leader Chung Jeom-sik said in a speech to the National Assembly as representative of the negotiating groups on the 8th, "There will be no constitutional amendment under a Lee Jae-myung government." Regarding the recent constitutional amendment arguments coming from the ruling camp, Chung said, "The government's No. 1 national task is erasing the president's crimes," and asked, "Could it be that President Lee intends to extend his term through a constitutional amendment to delay his own trial?" For a constitutional amendment to pass the National Assembly, approval from two-thirds or more of all sitting lawmakers (currently 299) is required, meaning cooperation from the People Power Party (109 seats) is necessary. <<> In his speech that day, Chung criticized 'President Lee Jae-myung' by mentioning him 15 times. He cited the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act, real estate measures, stock market instability, the Honam semiconductor project, and North Korea policy as the government's representative policy failures. He then said, "The People Power Party will take a completely different path from the Democratic Party," vowing to push for the full abolition of the early voting system, the restoration of prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers, and easing tax burdens for single-homeowners. <<> Regarding the recent second Cabinet reshuffle, Chung also harshly criticized it, saying, "The head of the group that withdrew the president's indictment and a person linked to allegations of fraud involving new drugs has become the justice minister nominee, and someone who served only twice as a proportional representative—a symbol of preferential treatment—has become the gender equality and family minister nominee." <<> When Chung said in his speech, "Politics like Hitler, economy like Chávez, term like Putin—this is exactly the Lee Jae-myung regime," Democratic Party lawmakers seated in the chamber shouted in protest. The speech was interrupted several times during this process. The Democratic Party criticized it as "provocative incitement at the level of far-right YouTubers," saying, "No citizen will pay attention to the People Power Party's behavior, which spews only language of hatred without even a shred of decency, let alone any alternative." <<> ◇Chung Jeom-sik: "President Lee Is Trying to Bury His Own Trial" <<> People Power Party floor leader Chung Jeom-sik devoted about 80% of his entire first speech as a National Assembly negotiating group representative to criticizing the government and ruling party. The 43-minute speech was interrupted several times as Democratic Party lawmakers protested. A People Power Party official said, "Given the public's anxiety over the government and ruling party's one-way operation of state affairs, there was a need to clearly declare war on their policy failures." <<> Regarding the complete abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers, Chung said, "The Democratic Party, out of hatred and vindictiveness toward the prosecution, finally forced open the gates of hell," adding, "The distortion of the judicial system will lead to poor investigations, and poor investigations will translate into suffering for the people." He then said, "Just as corrupt police bury cases, the president is trying to bury even his own trial." <<> He also mentioned 'real estate' 19 times, saying, "The president hasn't gone after real estate—he's gone after the people." Chung said, "A triple surge in sales, jeonse, and monthly rents is spreading across the capital region like dominoes," and "The president promised during his candidacy that he would not use taxes to curb real estate, but since taking office, his policies have been the exact opposite." The People Power Party plans to push during the September regular session of the National Assembly for the abolition of regulations on private redevelopment and reconstruction, easing tax burdens for single-homeowner households, and ultra-low-interest loan support for young people and newlyweds. <<> Democratic Party lawmakers in the plenary chamber protested several times during the speech. When Chung said, "The government is recklessly piling more debt on top of the nation's debt, truly carrying out a 'revolution of debt,'" shouts came from the Democratic Party seats, including, "They're even mocking the revolution of light." Also, when Chung emphasized the importance of deterring North Korea's nuclear weapons, some Democratic Party lawmakers retorted, "Aren't those who tried to start a war ashamed of themselves?" In response, People Power Party lawmakers fired back, saying, "Why are you yelling when we're trying to protect national security?" National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik intervened, asking for "cooperation so the session can proceed smoothly," but the verbal clash between the ruling and opposition lawmakers did not stop for some time. <<> Regarding the ballot shortage during the June 3 local elections, Chung said, "We will completely abolish the early voting system that can't even be managed and review extending the main voting period," adding, "We will also properly oversee the lax and arrogant National Election Commission." (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 8일 국회 교섭단체 대표 연설에서 “이재명 정부에서 개헌은 없다”고 밝혔다. 정 원내대표는 최근 여권에서 나오는 개헌 주장에 대해 “정부의 국정 과제 1호는 대통령 죄 지우기”라며 “혹시 이 대통령은 개헌으로 임기 연장해서 (자신의) 재판을 미루겠다는 의도인가”라고 했다. 개헌안이 국회를 통과하려면 재적 의원(현재 299명) 중 3분의 2 이상의 찬성이 필요해 국민의힘(109명)이 협조해야 한다.)

item.title: North Korea Crosses MDL Over 20 Times in One Month... More Incursions Than All of Last Year (北, 한 달간 MDL 20여회 침범… 작년 한 해보다 더 많이 넘어와)
item.description:
North Korea Crosses MDL Over 20 Times in One Month... More Incursions Than All of Last Year (北, 한 달간 MDL 20여회 침범… 작년 한 해보다 더 많이 넘어와)

North Korean troops crossed the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) more than 20 times last month alone, with the number of incursions in August exceeding the total for all of last year, it was learned on the 8th. Military authorities believe North Korean troops crossed the MDL 17 times last year, and this marks the first time that North Korean troops have been confirmed to have violated the MDL more times in a single month than in the entire previous year. MDL crossings carry the potential to violate the Armistice Agreement. However, since the United Nations Command makes the final determination on whether North Korean troops have crossed the line, South Korean forces have reportedly requested an investigation into the recent incursion circumstances. (북한군이 지난달에만 군사분계선(MDL)을 20회 이상 월선해, 8월 한 달간의 침범 횟수가 지난해 전체 월선 횟수를 넘어선 것으로 8일 알려졌다. 군 당국은 북한군이 지난해 17차례 MDL을 넘었다고 판단하고 있는데, 북한군이 지난달에만 그 이상 MDL을 침범했다는 사실이 확인된 것은 이번이 처음이다. MDL 월선은 정전협정 위반 소지가 있다. 다만 북한군의 월선 여부는 유엔군사령부가 최종 판단하는 만큼, 한국군은 최근의 월선 정황에 대한 조사를 요청한 것으로 알려졌다.)

According to multiple military officials, North Korean troop activity near the MDL, which had been quiet since November 28 of last year, began to be detected again from mid-last month on both the eastern and western fronts. Regarding this surge in North Korean MDL incursions, the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) stated on the same day, "Encroachment activities were identified as work operations proceeded on unfinished sections." After Kim Jong-un defined the two Koreas as "hostile rival states" in late 2023, North Korean troops have been conducting operations such as laying mines and installing barbed wire fences near the MDL since 2024. The JCS said these operations have resumed, and it is understood that they assess North Korea's provocative intent as limited. (복수의 군 관계자에 따르면 지난해 11월 28일 이후 잠잠했던 북한군의 MDL 월선 정황은 지난달 중순부터 동·서부 전선 모두에서 다시 포착되기 시작했다고 한다. 이 같은 북한군의 MDL 월선 정황 급증에 대해 합참은 이날 “미작업 구간에 대한 작업 활동이 진행되면서 침범 활동이 식별됐다”고 밝혔다. 김정은이 2023년 말 남북을 ‘적대적 두 국가’로 규정하자, 북한군은 2024년부터 MDL 일대에서 지뢰 매설, 철책 설치 등의 작업을 해왔다. 합참은 이런 작업이 재개됐으며, 북한군의 도발 의도는 크지 않다고 판단하는 것으로 전해졌다.)

Within the military, there is also discussion that changes in our surveillance posture may have led to an increase in reports of North Korean MDL crossings. According to a military source, recent North Korean MDL incursions have been concentrated at a specific point on the eastern front. In the past, this location lacked Thermal Observation Devices (TOD) that detect infrared signatures to track troop and equipment movements, but recently our military installed such equipment, eliminating the blind spot and allowing continuous detection of North Korean incursions across the MDL. (군 내에서는 우리 측 감시 태세 변화가 북한군의 MDL 월선 보고 증가로 이어졌을 가능성도 거론되고 있다. 군 소식통에 따르면 최근 북한군의 MDL 침범은 특히 동부 전선의 특정 지점에 집중돼 있는 것으로 전해졌다. 과거 이 지점에는 적외선을 감지해 병력과 장비 이동을 파악하는 열상감시장비(TOD)가 없었는데, 최근 우리 군이 장비를 설치해 사각지대가 해소되자 북한군의 MDL 월선 정황이 지속적으로 포착되고 있다는 것이다.)

At the newly installed TOD location, it has been reported that four to five personnel presumed to be North Korean troops, wearing civilian clothes and carrying rifles, are typically observed crossing the MDL and moving around. Whether North Korean troops used this route before the TOD installation has not been confirmed. A military source said, "In reality, there is a possibility that North Korean MDL crossings occurred frequently in more areas." (우리 군이 TOD를 신규 설치한 지점에서는 북한군으로 추정되는 사복을 입은 인원 4~5명 정도가 총기를 들고 MDL을 침범하며 이동하는 모습이 통상 포착되는 것으로 전해졌다. TOD 설치 이전에도 북한군이 이 경로로 이동했는지는 확인되지 않았다. 군 소식통은 “실제로는 더 많은 지역에서 북한군의 MDL 월선이 수시로 발생해 왔을 가능성이 있다”고 말했다.)

◇Even when North Korean troops cross back and forth... "Due to restraint orders on warning shots, many cases go without action" (◇북한군 넘나들어도… “경고사격 자제령에 조치 안하는 경우 많아”)

Since 2024, when North Korean construction near the MDL began, the JCS has discussed plans to deploy additional surveillance equipment to the front lines, and this year, having secured budget, it has been installing surveillance equipment in some sections. A military source said, "To install new surveillance equipment, we need to enter the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), but front-line units are concerned about safety incidents, so the work is progressing slowly." (합참은 북한군의 MDL 일대 공사가 시작된 2024년부터 전방에 감시 장비를 추가 배치하는 안을 논의했고, 올해 예산을 확보해 일부 구간에 감시 장비를 설치하고 있다. 군 소식통은 “감시 장비를 새로 설치하기 위해 비무장지대(DMZ) 내에 진입해야 하는데, 전방 부대가 안전사고 등을 우려해 작업 속도가 더딘 것으로 안다”고 말했다.)

Military authorities stated that in mid-last month, North Korean troops crossed the MDL on the eastern front, prompting this year's first warning shots. However, this does not mean North Korean troops did not cross the MDL at all from December of last year to July of this year; rather, there may have been MDL crossings that our military failed to detect previously due to a lack of surveillance equipment. (군 당국은 지난달 중순 북한군이 동부전선 MDL을 침범해서 올해 첫 경고 사격을 했다고 밝혔다. 하지만 북한군이 지난해 12월부터 올해 7월까지 단 한 차례도 MDL을 침범하지 않았던 것이 아니라, 감시 장비 부족으로 이전에 우리 군이 미처 인지하지 못한 MDL 침범 사례가 있었을 수도 있다는 것이다.)

It has also been suggested that the revelation that the Army's 1st Corps, responsible for front-line defense on the western front, had not loaded live ammunition into key shared weapons may have influenced events, prompting the Ministry of National Defense to launch a "Joint Special Discipline Inspection Task Force" from early August to check front-line guard operations. (서부 전선 최전방 경계를 맡는 육군 1군단이 핵심 공용화기 등에 실탄을 장전하지 않고 있었던 사실이 드러나, 8월 초부터 국방부가 ‘합동 특별 기강 점검 TF’를 통해 전방 경계 작전 점검에 나선 것이 영향을 줬을 가능성도 제기된다.)

According to this newspaper's reporting, the presidential office around November of last year conveyed to military authorities its intent to "refrain from firing warning shots when North Korean troops cross the MDL." At the end of last year, a senior Ministry of National Defense official instructed front-line troops to "assess whether shooting is necessary before conducting warning shots," which sparked controversy, and this appears to indicate that there was indeed such guidance from the presidential office behind it. One retired general said, "In that kind of atmosphere, situations on the ground that should have been judged as North Korean MDL crossings may have frequently been let go without action." (본지 취재에 따르면 청와대는 지난해 11월쯤 군 당국에 ‘북한군이 MDL을 넘었을 때 경고 사격을 자제하라’는 뜻을 전달했다고 한다. 지난해 연말 국방부 고위 관계자가 일선에 “경고 사격을 하기에 앞서 사격 필요 상황 평가부터 하라”고 지시한 사실이 알려져 논란이 된 적 있는데, 실은 이와 관련한 청와대의 지침이 있었다는 취지로 풀이된다. 한 예비역 장성은 “그런 분위기라면 이전까지 현장 부대에서 북한군의 MDL 월선으로 판단할 상황도 그냥 넘어가는 일이 비일비재했을 수 있다”고 말했다.)

It is also possible that North Korean operations near the MDL actually increased in August. In May, Kim Jong-un summoned division and brigade commanders across the military and emphasized "strengthening first-line units guarding the southern border and making the border an impregnable fortress." There are analyses suggesting this led to increased North Korean activities this summer. (실제 북한군의 MDL 일대 작업이 8월에 증가했을 가능성도 있다. 김정은은 지난 5월 전군의 사단·여단 지휘관을 소집해 “남부 국경을 지키고 있는 제1선 부대들을 강화하고 국경선을 난공불락의 요새”로 만들라고 강조했다. 이것이 올여름 북한군의 작업 증가로 이어졌을 것이란 분석도 나온다.)

The JCS stated on the same day, "Our military is closely monitoring activities such as North Korea's MDL incursions while maintaining a firm military readiness posture. The military is taking principled measures in accordance with operational procedures and continues to pursue force enhancement efforts." (합참은 이날 “우리 군은 북한의 MDL 침범 등 활동을 면밀하게 감시하면서, 확고한 군사 대비 태세를 유지하고 있다”며 “군은 작전 수행 절차에 따른 원칙적인 조치를 하고 있고 전력 보강 등을 지속 추진하고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: U.S. Cites November Election, Urges Dispatch of Troops (美, 11월 선거 거론 “파병 서둘러달라”)
item.description:
U.S. Cites November Election, Urges Dispatch of Troops (美, 11월 선거 거론 “파병 서둘러달라”)

It was confirmed on the 8th that the South Korean government sent a survey team to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) as part of the preparatory procedures for dispatching troops to the Strait of Hormuz. There are also remarks that the U.S. side conveyed a stance urging South Korea to "hasten the troop dispatch," referencing the midterm elections (November 3rd). With U.S. President Donald Trump recently applying public pressure for the dispatch on multiple occasions, attention is focused on whether the deployment of the local inspection team will accelerate follow-up steps, such as submitting a motion for parliamentary consent to the dispatch. <<> According to multiple sources, the Ministry of National Defense dispatched an on-site survey team over the past weekend to the UAE, a nation adjacent to the Strait of Hormuz that hosts U.S. military bases. The purpose is reportedly to assess in advance the local combat situation, military strongholds, and port locations, as well as to examine how and through which routes South Korean forces could receive maintenance and supplies if deployed. Since the naval logistics support ship initially considered for the dispatch is projected to take about a month just to travel to the Strait of Hormuz, there are observations that the likelihood of deploying air assets such as patrol aircraft is high. The UAE hosts Al Dhafra Air Base, an air hub used jointly by U.S. forces. <<> If the government envisions dispatching troops by November in consideration of the U.S. midterm elections, the decision on whether to send forces to Hormuz must be made within this month, given the parliamentary consent procedures. Lawmakers Lee Ki-heon and Kim Yong-min of the Democratic Party of Korea, along with pro-government parties, have already expressed opposition to the dispatch, suggesting that passing the parliamentary ratification motion may face difficulties. Iran has also warned of retaliation, stating that "militarily stationing or participating in operations in the Strait of Hormuz will have serious consequences." <<> The Ministry of National Defense stated on the same day, "It is not true that the U.S. requested the dispatch of our assets to the Strait of Hormuz with a set deadline (of November)," adding, "Nothing has been decided regarding the dispatch." It also said the dispatch of the on-site survey team "is not premised on a troop deployment." Hong Ik-pyo, senior presidential secretary for political affairs at the Blue House, said on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel regarding the dispatch, "There are those who think we should play a role in the ROK-U.S. relationship, and there are also internal views expressing some concern about that," adding, "Once the President returns from his overseas trip, further discussions will be needed." (우리 정부가 호르무즈 해협 파병을 위한 준비 절차의 일환으로 아랍에미리트(UAE)에 실사단을 파견한 것으로 8일 확인됐다. 미국 측이 ‘파병을 서둘러 달라’는 취지의 입장을 한국 정부에 전달하며 중간선거(11월 3일) 일정을 거론했다는 말도 나온다. 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 최근 여러 차례 파병을 공개 압박한 가운데, 현지 조사단 파견으로 국회 파병 동의안 제출 등 후속 절차에 가속도가 붙을지 주목된다.)

item.title: French President Macron Condemns North Korea's Support for Russia; Korea and France to Cooperate on Reopening Hormuz (佛 마크롱, “北 러 지원” 규탄… 韓·佛 호르무즈 재개 공조)
item.description:
French President Macron Condemns North Korea's Support for Russia; Korea and France to Cooperate on Reopening Hormuz (佛 마크롱, “北 러 지원” 규탄… 韓·佛 호르무즈 재개 공조)

French President Emmanuel Macron, during a joint press conference held immediately after his summit with President Lee Jae-myung on the 8th (local time), strongly condemned North Korea's support for Russia's war of aggression and expressed unwavering support for peace on the Korean Peninsula. He also formalized the two countries' close cooperation on reopening the Strait of Hormuz in the Middle East and ensuring freedom of navigation. (에마뉘엘 마크롱 프랑스 대통령이 8일(현지 시각) 이재명 대통령과의 정상회담 직후 가진 공동 언론 발표에서 북한의 러시아 침략 전쟁 지원을 강력히 규탄하고 한반도 평화에 대한 변함없는 지지를 표명했다. 아울러 중동 호르무즈 해협의 재개와 항행의 자유를 위한 양국의 긴밀한 공조 방침을 공식화했다.)

On this day, President Macron reaffirmed that the two countries share a strong common vision regarding North Korea's violations of international law and threats to security on the Korean Peninsula. President Macron stated, "North Korea is now unhesitatingly providing support to Russia's war of aggression in Ukraine," and added, "On this, the two countries share a common vision of an international order based on international law." (이날 마크롱 대통령은 북한의 국제법 위반 행위와 한반도 안보 위협에 대해 양국이 강력한 공동 비전을 공유하고 있음을 재확인했다. 마크롱 대통령은 “북한이 이제는 러시아의 우크라이나 침략 전쟁에 서슴없이 지원을 하고 있다”며 “이에 대해 양국은 국제법에 기반한 국제 질서에 대한 공동 비전을 공유하고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

He continued, "We intend to cooperate closely with South Korea in addressing major challenges to international security and stability," and said, "For peace and security on the Korean Peninsula, the Republic of Korea can always trust in France's unwavering support." (이어 “국제 안보와 안정의 주요 과제에 대응해 한국과 긴밀히 협력하고자 한다”며 “한반도의 평화와 안전을 위해 대한민국은 프랑스의 변함없는 지지를 언제나 신뢰하셔도 좋다”고 했다.)

The two leaders also placed significant focus on discussing security cooperation measures to ensure stability in the Middle East region, beyond the Korean Peninsula, and to secure major maritime shipping routes. President Macron said, "In the Middle East as well, we must find freedom of navigation and, above all, a peaceful solution," and noted, "Following up on discussions from last April, we reviewed what role we could play, including alongside the United Kingdom, to reopen the Strait of Hormuz." He added, "We will work together to restore peace in the region," and "The multinational mission is peaceful in nature, and we will continue cooperation immediately once the relevant consent is obtained." (양국 정상은 한반도를 넘어 중동 지역의 안정 및 주요 해상 수송로 확보를 위한 안보 협력 방안도 비중 있게 논의했다. 마크롱 대통령은 “중동에서도 항행의 자유, 그리고 무엇보다 평화로운 해결책을 찾아야 한다”며 “지난 4월 논의에 이어 호르무즈 해협의 재개를 위해 영국을 포함해 어떠한 역할을 할 수 있는지 검토했다”고 했다. 그러면서 “이 지역의 평화를 되찾기 위해 협력하겠다”며 “다국적 임무는 평화적인 것으로서 관련 동의가 구해지는 대로 즉시 협력을 이어갈 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: The Blind Spot of Tricks and Privileges... Satellite Parties Became Hosts for Underqualified Politicians (꼼수와 특혜의 사각지대… 위성정당, 자격 미달 정치인의 숙주 됐다)
item.description:
The Blind Spot of Tricks and Privileges... Satellite Parties Became Hosts for Underqualified Politicians (꼼수와 특혜의 사각지대… 위성정당, 자격 미달 정치인의 숙주 됐다)

The controversy over the qualifications of Basic Income Party lawmaker Yong Hye-in (proportional representative), nominated as the Minister of Gender Equality and Family, has brought the problems of "satellite parties" back into the spotlight. Candidate Yong ran as a proportional candidate for the Labor Party in the 2016 general election but lost when the party received only 0.38% of the vote. Afterward, she worked in minor parties before joining the Democratic Party of Korea's satellite party as a candidate in the 2020 and 2024 general elections, winning a proportional seat twice in a row. In political and academic circles, voices are emerging that satellite parties, which distort voters' choices, should be eliminated, citing Candidate Yong's case as an example. <<> ◇Claimed diversity, but controversial lawmakers entered <<> A satellite party is a "one-off party" created to secure the maximum number of seats under the current "semi-parallel proportional representation system." The Democratic Party of Korea and the Justice Party introduced the semi-parallel proportional representation system ahead of the 2020 general election, and it remains in effect today. <<> Under this system, a party that wins many constituency seats in a general election ends up with fewer proportional seats. Creating a separate proportional party is thus advantageous for securing seats. At the time, Na Kyung-won, then floor leader of the Liberty Korea Party (now People Power Party), warned, "If amendments to the election law create the ruling party's second and third battalions, the legislature's check on the executive branch will be rendered powerless," but the Democratic Party and the Justice Party pushed through the election law amendment and the bill to establish the Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials as fast-track items. <<> Despite claims of party diversity, the results were different. In the 2020 general election, out of 47 proportional seats, Future Korea Party, the satellite party of the United Future Party (now People Power Party), took 19 seats, and Platform Party, the Democratic Party's satellite party, took 17. In the 2024 general election, out of 46 proportional seats, People's Future, the People Power Party's satellite party, took 18, and Democratic Alliance of Korea, the Democratic Party's satellite party, took 14. After the elections, both ruling and opposition satellite parties each collected approximately 2.8 billion won in state subsidies (based on the 2024 general election) granted to small and medium-sized parties (5–19 seats) under the law, then merged with their parent parties. <<> When the Democratic Party created a satellite party, it placed candidates from minor parties such as the Progressive Party, Basic Income Party, and Social Democratic Party within proportional election-winning ranks under the banner of "coalition politics." In this process, unvetted candidates became National Assembly members under the signboard of the Democratic Party's satellite party. Some became embroiled in various controversies or faced investigations and trials, failing to carry out their duties properly. Shin Yul, a professor of political science and diplomacy at Myongji University, said, "The name Democratic Alliance of Korea is essentially telling voters to vote for the Democratic Party" and added, "Representative democracy is premised on voters delegating part of their rights, but here, they cannot even properly know to whom they are delegating." <<> ◇Even controversies over sham expulsions and refusal to rejoin parties <<> In the case of the Democratic Party's satellite party, ahead of its merger with the Democratic Party after the election, it conducted "sham expulsions" to send lawmakers from minor parties back to their original parties. This exploited the rule that proportional representatives lose their seats if they voluntarily leave their party, but retain them if expelled. For instance, Democratic Alliance of Korea, the Democratic Party's satellite party, expelled four elected members who originally belonged to the Progressive Party, Basic Income Party, and Social Democratic Party immediately after the 2024 general election, with the nominal reason being "violation of party discipline by opposing the merger with the Democratic Party." Conversely, lawmaker Kim Nam-kuk, who had left the Democratic Party amid a coin controversy, made a "detour back" by joining Democratic Alliance of Korea. <<> Progressive Party lawmaker Son Sol was placed 15th on Democratic Alliance of Korea's proportional candidate list in the 2024 general election, but when seats went up to the 14th spot, she did not return to the Progressive Party after the election and remained with the Democratic Party. More than a year after the general election, in June of last year, when lawmaker Wi Sung-rak left to become head of the National Security Office, she inherited the proportional seat and was expelled unanimously at a Democratic Party lawmakers' meeting before rejoining the Progressive Party. Independent lawmaker Choi Hyeok-jin ran as the Basic Income Party's share under the satellite party and inherited a proportional seat in June of last year, but said he would stay with the Democratic Party rather than rejoin the Basic Income Party. Independent Choi is reportedly attempting to rejoin the Democratic Party again. <<> Kim Sung-soo, a professor of political science and diplomacy at Hanyang University, said, "The recent controversies over satellite parties are deepening voters' political distrust" and added, "The proportional representation election system should be simplified, and satellite parties must be institutionally blocked." (성평등가족부 장관 후보자로 지명된 기본소득당 용혜인(비례) 의원 자질 논란을 계기로 ‘위성정당’의 문제점이 재조명되고 있다. 용 후보자는 2016년 총선에서 노동당 비례 후보로 출마했지만 노동당이 0.38% 득표율에 그치며 낙선했다. 이후 소수 정당에서 활동하다 2020년과 2024년 총선 때 더불어민주당 위성정당 후보로 합류해 비례 의원에 두 번 연속 당선됐다. 정치권과 학계에선 용 후보자 사례를 들어 유권자의 선택을 왜곡하는 위성정당을 없애야 한다는 목소리가 나온다.)

item.title: From AI to Nuclear Fuel... Korea and France Forge a 'Technology and Security Alliance' (AI부터 핵연료까지… 韓·佛, ‘기술·안보 동맹’으로)
item.description:
From AI to Nuclear Fuel... Korea and France Forge a 'Technology and Security Alliance' (AI부터 핵연료까지… 韓·佛, ‘기술·안보 동맹’으로)

Korea and France have agreed to expand the scope of their cooperation beyond industrial exchanges to international security issues such as the Strait of Hormuz, Ukraine, and the Korean Peninsula. They will also strengthen strategic cooperation networks spanning artificial intelligence (AI) and semiconductors to nuclear fuel and military logistics support. The plan is to combine France's strengths in AI, space, and nuclear energy source technologies with Korea's semiconductor and manufacturing competitiveness to advance joint research into tangible investments and business ventures, while building stable supply chains linking the two countries in nuclear fuel and defense sectors. (한국과 프랑스가 산업 교류를 넘어 호르무즈 해협과 우크라이나, 한반도 등 국제 안보 현안으로 협력의 범위를 넓히기로 합의했다. 인공지능(AI)과 반도체부터 핵연료·군수 지원까지 전략적 협력망도 강화한다. 프랑스가 강점을 가진 AI·우주·원자력 원천 기술과 한국의 반도체·제조 경쟁력을 결합해 공동 연구를 실제 투자와 사업으로 발전시키고, 핵연료와 군수 분야에서는 양국을 잇는 안정적인 공급망을 구축한다는 것이다.)

President Lee Jae-myung and French President Emmanuel Macron held a summit at the Élysée Palace in Paris on the 8th (local time) and agreed to strengthen cooperation across six areas: defense and security, economy and industry, cutting-edge technology, people-to-people exchanges, culture, and international affairs. Rather than remaining a government-to-government declaration, the summit created an implementation structure extending to Samsung Electronics and Mistral AI's investment and technology cooperation, Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power and Orano's enrichment and reprocessing cooperation, and military information, logistics, and training cooperation between the two armed forces. (이재명 대통령과 에마뉘엘 마크롱 프랑스 대통령은 8일(현지 시각) 파리 엘리제궁에서 정상회담을 열고 이 같은 내용의 국방·안보와 경제·산업, 첨단 기술, 인적 교류, 문화, 국제 현안 등 6개 분야의 협력을 강화하기로 했다. 정부 간 협력 선언에 머무르지 않고 삼성전자와 미스트랄AI의 투자·기술 협력, 한국수력원자력과 오라노의 농축·재처리 협력, 양국 군의 정보·군수·훈련 협력으로 이어지는 실행 구조를 만든 것이다.)

A representative example is the investment agreement between Samsung Electronics and France's Mistral AI. Samsung Electronics will participate as a strategic investor in Mistral AI and jointly develop a dedicated AI model for internal Samsung use. The core objective is not simply to adopt a general-purpose AI service, but to build a customized model that protects and leverages Samsung Electronics' semiconductor expertise. (대표적인 사례가 삼성전자와 프랑스 미스트랄AI의 투자 협약이다. 삼성전자는 미스트랄AI에 전략적 투자자로 참여하고 삼성 내부에서 사용할 전용 AI 모델을 공동 개발한다. 단순히 범용 AI 서비스를 도입하는 것이 아니라 삼성전자의 반도체 노하우를 보호하면서 활용할 수 있는 맞춤형 모델을 구축하는 게 핵심이다.)

This marks the concretization, just five months later, of the letter of intent on AI, semiconductor, and quantum technology cooperation signed by the two governments in April, now realized through inter-corporate investment and technology collaboration. The two countries also signed a follow-up memorandum of understanding (MOU) to support joint research and development (R&D), mutual market access for startups, and exchanges and business opportunity discovery between semiconductor companies and research institutions. (이는 지난 4월 양국 정부가 체결한 AI·반도체·양자 기술 협력 의향서가 5개월 만에 기업 간 투자와 기술 협력으로 구체화한 것이다. 양국은 공동 연구·개발(R&D), 스타트업의 상호 시장 진출, 반도체 기업과 연구기관 간 교류 및 사업 기회 발굴을 지원하는 후속 양해각서(MOU)도 체결했다.)

President Lee stated, "We have agreed to specify cooperation to connect advanced industries and science technologies—such as AI, quantum, space, nuclear energy, and bio—to industries and markets," adding, "We will pursue concrete cooperation measures such as expanding mutual market access for startups from both countries and joint R&D between companies and research institutions." To support this, the two countries will establish ministerial-level industrial strategy dialogues and sectoral working groups. These frameworks will address not only industrial policy, trade, and investment but also supply chains, critical minerals, and industrial technology. (이 대통령은 “AI·양자·우주·원자력·바이오 등 첨단 산업과 과학기술을 산업과 시장으로 연결하기 위한 협력을 구체화해 나가기로 했다”며 “양국 스타트업의 상호 시장 접근 확대와 기업·연구기관 간 공동 R&D와 같은 구체적인 협력 방안을 추진하겠다”고 했다. 양국은 이를 뒷받침하기 위해 장관급 산업 전략 대화와 분야별 작업반을 신설한다. 산업 정책과 교역·투자뿐만 아니라 공급망·핵심 광물과 산업 기술까지 하나의 협의 틀에서 다룬다.)

Based on this, the two leaders set a goal of achieving $20 billion in bilateral trade by 2030. President Lee emphasized, "We will continue to communicate closely so that companies from both countries can operate in a stable and predictable environment and create more opportunities in each other's markets." (양국 정상은 이를 토대로 2030년까지 교역액 200억달러를 달성한다는 목표를 세웠다. 이 대통령은 “양국 기업들이 안정적이고 예측 가능한 환경에서 활동하며 서로의 시장에서 더 많은 기회를 창출할 수 있도록 계속 긴밀히 소통해 나가겠다”고 강조했다.)

In the nuclear energy sector, both technology development and supply chain stability will be pursued simultaneously. Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power will push forward long-term enrichment services supply cooperation based on France's Orano's new enrichment facility. While this is not yet a final contract with confirmed supply volumes and prices, it establishes basic principles for negotiating a long-term agreement, laying the groundwork to secure Western enrichment services preemptively. Enrichment services are central to the nuclear fuel supply process required for power plant operations. Securing a stable supplier over the long term can reduce risks stemming from international developments or supply disruptions. (원자력 분야에서는 기술 개발과 공급망 안정을 동시에 추진한다. 한국수력원자력은 프랑스 오라노의 신규 농축 시설을 기반으로 장기 농축역무(서비스) 공급 협력을 추진한다. 아직 공급 물량과 가격을 확정한 본계약은 아니지만, 장기 계약 협의를 위한 기본 원칙을 세워 서구권 농축 서비스를 선제적으로 확보할 기반을 마련했다. 농축 서비스는 원전 가동에 필요한 핵연료 공급 과정의 핵심이다. 안정적인 공급처를 장기간 확보하면 국제 정세나 공급 차질에 따른 위험을 줄일 수 있다.)

The two countries will also open a high-level dialogue channel for civilian nuclear cooperation. The Korea Atomic Energy Research Institute and France's Framatome will sign an MOU on a separate occasion to pursue joint research on next-generation small modular reactor (SMR) safety technologies, basic nuclear science, and waste management. Apart from competing for market share in overseas nuclear power plant projects, Korea and France intend to expand cooperation space in areas of shared interest, such as fuel supply chains and next-generation reactor technologies. (양국은 민간 원자력 협력을 위한 고위급 대화 채널도 개설한다. 한국원자력연구원과 프랑스 프라마톰은 별도 계기에 MOU를 체결하고 차세대 소형 모듈 원자로(SMR) 안전 기술과 원자력 기초과학, 폐기물 관리 분야의 공동 연구를 추진할 예정이다. 한국과 프랑스가 해외 원전 시장 점유율을 놓고 경쟁하는 것과 별개로, 연료 공급망과 차세대 원자로 기술 등 공동의 이해가 있는 분야에서는 협력 공간을 넓히겠다는 의미다.)

President Lee explained, "Through cooperation in nuclear R&D and fuel supply, we have agreed to deepen collaboration in developing next-generation reactors and diversifying supply chains over the medium to long term." (이 대통령은 “원자력 연구개발과 연료 공급 분야의 협력을 통해 차세대 원자로 개발과 중장기적인 공급망 다변화 측면에서 협력을 더욱 심화해 나가기로 했다”고 설명했다.)

Security cooperation will also expand one step further—from military information exchanges to logistics support and actual exercises. The two countries signed an amendment protocol to the military information security agreement, reorganizing the institutional foundation for information sharing. They also agreed to swiftly conclude a mutual logistics support agreement (MLSA) that prioritizes the provision of goods and services during wartime and peacetime, with subsequent cost settlement. Once the mutual logistics agreement is signed, the two militaries can exchange necessary support more rapidly during joint exercises or overseas missions. (안보 협력 역시 군사 정보 교환에서 군수와 실제 훈련으로 한 단계 확장한다. 양국은 군사비밀정보보호협정 개정의정서에 서명해 정보 교류의 제도적 기반을 정비했다. 전·평시 물자와 용역 등을 우선 지원한 뒤 사후 정산하는 상호군수지원협정도 조속히 체결하기로 했다. 상호 군수 지원 협정이 체결되면 양국 군이 합동 훈련이나 해외 임무를 수행할 때 필요한 지원을 보다 신속하게 주고받을 수 있다.)

Next week, the two countries' air forces will conduct the joint 'Pegasus' exercise in Seoul, and in the second half of this year, mutual port visits by the two navies are scheduled. The two countries also agreed to identify cooperation projects that combine France's defense technology capabilities with Korea's manufacturing competitiveness. (다음 주 서울에서는 양국 공군의 ‘페가스’ 합동 훈련이 실시되고, 올해 하반기에는 양국 해군의 상호 기항이 예정돼 있다. 프랑스의 방산 기술력과 한국의 제조 경쟁력을 결합한 협력 사업도 발굴하기로 했다.)

item.title: Lee Holds Summit with French President Macron... Strong Cooperation on 'Freedom of Navigation in the Strait of Hormuz' (李, 佛 마크롱과 정상회담… ‘호르무즈 항행 자유’ 강력 공조)
item.description:
Lee Holds Summit with French President Macron... Strong Cooperation on 'Freedom of Navigation in the Strait of Hormuz' (李, 佛 마크롱과 정상회담… ‘호르무즈 항행 자유’ 강력 공조)

President Lee Jae-myung stated at the joint press conference following the South Korea-France summit held at the Élysée Palace in Paris, France, on the 8th (local time), that he would cooperate strongly with the international community, including France, to secure freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz in the Middle East and ensure the stability of global supply chains. (이재명 대통령이 8일(현지 시각) 프랑스 파리 엘리제궁에서 열린 한·프랑스 정상회담 공동 언론 발표에서 중동 호르무즈 해협의 항행의 자유 확보와 글로벌 공급망 안정을 위해 프랑스를 비롯한 국제사회와 강력히 공조하겠다고 밝혔다.)

President Lee referenced the discussions at the meeting on the Strait of Hormuz led by France and the United Kingdom last April, emphasizing the importance of stability in the Middle East region to South Korea's energy security and global supply chains. (이 대통령은 지난 4월 프랑스와 영국이 주도한 호르무즈 해협 관련 회의 논의를 언급하며, 중동 지역의 안정이 한국의 에너지 안보와 글로벌 공급망에 미치는 중요성을 피력했다.)

President Lee said, "In April, we participated in the meeting on the Strait of Hormuz led by France and the United Kingdom, and expressed the Republic of Korea's commitment to contributing to the stability of the strait and freedom of navigation," adding, "The Republic of Korea and France have agreed to continue close cooperation so that freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and the stability of global supply chains can be restored as soon as possible." (이 대통령은 “지난 4월 프랑스와 영국이 주도한 호르무즈 해협 회의에 참여해 해협의 안정과 항행의 자유를 위한 대한민국의 기여 의지를 밝힌 바 있다”며 “대한민국과 프랑스는 호르무즈 해협에서의 항행의 자유, 글로벌 공급망의 안정이 조속히 회복될 수 있도록 긴밀한 공조를 계속 이어나가기로 했다”고 했다.)

The Strait of Hormuz is a major transport route for crude oil imported by South Korea and a critical choke point for global maritime logistics. If blockaded, it would deal an immediate blow to the domestic economy and industrial supply chains. The government has continuously consulted with allied nations on its willingness to participate with military assets and contribute to multilateral cooperation mechanisms to ensure safe passage through the strait, contingent on domestic legal procedures such as consultations with the National Assembly. (호르무즈 해협은 한국이 수입하는 원유의 주요 수송로이자 글로벌 해상 물류의 핵심 초크포인트(Choke Point)로, 봉쇄 시 국내 경제와 산업 공급망에 즉각적인 타격을 주는 요충지다. 정부는 국회 협의 등 국내법적 절차를 전제로 해협 내 통항 안전을 위한 군사적 자산 참여 및 다국적 공조 메커니즘 기여 의사를 우방국들과 지속적으로 협의해 왔다.)

French President Emmanuel Macron responded, saying, "In the Middle East as well, we must seek freedom of navigation and peaceful solutions," adding, "We will push forward a multinational mission, including with the United Kingdom, to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, and we will actively cooperate with South Korea as soon as the relevant consent is obtained." (에마뉘엘 마크롱 프랑스 대통령 역시 “중동에서도 항행의 자유와 평화로운 해결책을 찾아야 한다”며 “호르무즈 해협의 재개를 위해 영국을 포함해 다국적 임무를 추진하고, 관련 동의가 구해지는 대로 한국과 적극적으로 협력하겠다”고 화답했다.)

item.title: Whistleblower: "Broker Ms. Yang was the Queen of Lobbying" (공익 신고자 “브로커 양씨는 로비의 여왕”)
item.description:
Whistleblower: "Broker Ms. Yang was the Queen of Lobbying" (공익 신고자 “브로커 양씨는 로비의 여왕”)

A female broker, Yang (47), who lobbied the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety for a COVID-19 new drug through Ministry of Justice nominee Kim Seung-won, reportedly not only mentioned Kim but also named other political figures to flaunt her connections, according to reports on the 8th. (김승원 법무부 후보자를 통해 식품의약품안전처에 ‘코로나 신약 로비’를 벌인 여성 브로커 양모(47)씨는 김 후보자뿐만 아니라 다른 정치권 인사들도 언급하며 주변에 인맥을 과시했던 것으로 8일 전해졌다.)

Cho, a whistleblower in the new drug lobbying case, said in an interview with this publication, "Ms. Yang was the 'Queen of Lobbying'" and "She frequently dropped the names of politicians that ordinary people wouldn't even know." According to a recording released by Cho, during a call with Cho in November 2021, Yang said of Kim, "He's a complete insider with Moon (President Moon Jae-in), and he handles everything from legal, administrative, and document drafting for Uncle Lee Jae-myung, among other things." Yang added, "I'm with the People's Party (People Power Party), whatever—I have lines on that side too," and "It doesn't matter who wins." The call took place about three months before the 2022 presidential election, and Yang appeared to emphasize that she could lobby the political sphere regardless of which party came to power. <<> In a conversation between Yang and Kang, founder of pharmaceutical company Genencel, released that day by independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, Yang also named several politicians from the ruling bloc. According to the recording Han posted on Facebook, during a call with Kang on September 1, 2021, Yang said, "I really know a lot of key figures in this administration," rattling off names such as Democratic Party chief of staff special team leader Choi Jae-sung, floor leader Han Byung-do, lawmaker Song Young-gil, and former lawmaker Lee Nak-yon. Conversely, Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Dong-ah said the previous day, "There are suspicions that broker Ms. Yang was also connected to former President Yoon Suk Yeol's presidential campaign." <<> Opposition circles speculate that Yang may have built her connections while running entertainment bars in Gangnam, Seoul, in the past. Kim, the nominee, also said the previous day that he first met Yang "as a customer at restaurants and cafés frequented by legal professionals." He called her a "successful businesswoman" and a "good junior." Kim defended Yang in 2011 when she was indicted on charges of failing to pay back wages to entertainment bar employees. <<> Yang founded a cosmetics company in 2014, and based on that, she reportedly operated as a "female entrepreneur," meeting notable figures at various events. Her social media accounts have since been deleted. Yang came under prosecution investigation in 2022 on suspicion of lobbying the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, and her cosmetics company went bankrupt in December 2023. Yang is currently on trial on charges including promising to bribe Kim in exchange for lobbying the ministry. (신약 로비 사건의 공익 신고자 조모씨는 본지 인터뷰에서 “양씨는 ‘로비의 여왕’이었다”며 “보통 사람들은 잘 알지도 못하는 정치인의 이름을 수시로 거론했다”고 했다. 조씨가 공개한 녹취록에 따르면, 양씨는 2021년 11월 조씨와의 통화에서 김 후보자에 대해 “문통(문재인 대통령)의 완전 측근이고 이재명 아저씨의 법률, 행정, 문서 작성 뭐부터 해서 아무튼 하고 있다”고 했다. 양씨는 이어 “나는 국민의당(국민의힘)이야 뭐야, 저쪽도 라인이 있다”며 “누가 돼도 상관은 없다”고 했다. 통화가 이뤄진 시점은 2022년 대선을 3개월쯤 앞둔 때로, 어느 정당이 집권하더라도 자신은 정치권 로비가 가능하다고 강조한 것으로 보인다.)
